leaveDescription: Your seat and color will be released.
hostHandoff: A connected player will take over as host.
submitted: Question submitted. Your yes vote is included.
rulesIntro: Choose A or B before the timer runs out. Your choice stays secret until everyone has voted or time is up.
rulesMajority: The choice with more submitted votes wins. Ties and missed votes earn zero. Minority votes, ties, and missed votes reset your streak.
clockTitle: Keep an eye on the clock
clockRules: Normal rounds last 20 seconds. Every fourth round is an 8-second Blitz. Every fifth round doubles your points. Round 20 combines both.
customRules: In the lobby, write a dilemma or import a deck code. Each question needs approval from at least two-thirds of connected players within 20 seconds, rounded up. Your submission includes your yes vote. Rejected questions stay locked for the room session.
deckRules: Approved custom questions come first in the next game, followed by shuffled questions from the selected deck. A theme changes the look only.
connectionRules: Refresh to reclaim your seat. A lost connection gets a 12-second grace period before becoming inactive. Submitted votes still count. The host role passes to a connected player if needed.
replayRules: Play again keeps your room, colors, settings and custom questions. Rooms expire after six hours without activity; export custom questions to keep them for future sessions.
languageRules: Each player can choose English, Spanish, or French. Built-in questions have the same meaning and choices in every language. Changing language does not change your vote, score, theme, or deck.
offlineHint: Check your internet connection, then try again. Your seat stays saved while the room is available.
newBallot: A new question needs your vote.
questionApproved: Custom question approved and added to the deck.
questionRejected: Question rejected. It is locked for this session.
seatReleased: Your seat was released. You can join again.
roomClosed: This room has closed. Create or join a new room.
